knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

```{r load_packages, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(modelr)
library(car)
library(olsrr)
```


```{r read_data, include=FALSE}
# Load the cleaned bond dataset.
# Note: This dataset is omitted from this GitHub repo
data_path <- "data/Cleaned_Bond_Data_Final.csv"
  if (!file.exists(data_path)) {
  stop("The raw data has been omitted from this repository due to proprietary licensing. Please see the compiled PDF report for full outputs and figures.")
}
bond_data <- read.csv(data_path)
#head(bond_data, n = 10)
```



\newpage


## Figure 1: Descriptive Statistics of Predictor Variables

```{r}

summary(
  bond_data[, c("total_debt_ebitda", "ebitda_margin", "market_value", "sales")]
  )

# 
table(bond_data$time_to_maturity)

bond_data |> 
  count(rbics_economy) |> 
  ggplot() +
    geom_col(
      aes(x = fct_reorder(rbics_economy, n), y = n), 
      color = "black", fill = "white"
      ) +
    labs(
      x = "Sector",
      y = "Frequency",
      title = "Frequency of RBICS Sectors",
      subtitle = "Data is from 1081 bonds issued in the past year"
    ) +
    coord_flip()

```
\newpage

## Figure 2: Descriptive Statistics of the Response Variable

```{r}

ggplot(data = bond_data, aes(x = yield_to_maturity)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, color = "black", fill = "white") + 
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of Yield to Maturity for Senior Secured Bonds",
    subtitle = "Data is from 1081 bonds issued in the past year",
    x = "Yield to Maturity (in %)",
    y = "Frequency"
    )

summary(bond_data$yield_to_maturity)
paste0("Standard Deviation: ", round(sd(bond_data$yield_to_maturity), 4))

```


\newpage

## Figure 3: Scatterplot Matrix and Multicollinearity Diagnostics for the Initial Model

```{r}
plot(~ yield_to_maturity + total_debt_ebitda + ebitda_margin + market_value, data = bond_data)

bond_data |> 
  select(yield_to_maturity, total_debt_ebitda, ebitda_margin, market_value) |> 
  cor()

vif(lm(yield_to_maturity ~ total_debt_ebitda + ebitda_margin + market_value, data = bond_data))

```



\newpage

## Figure 4: Initial Model Summary and Diagnostic Plots

```{r}
lm_yield <- lm(yield_to_maturity ~ total_debt_ebitda + ebitda_margin + market_value + 
                 time_to_maturity, data = bond_data)
summary(lm_yield)


plot(lm_yield, which = 1, id.n = 0, add.smooth = FALSE)

plot(lm_yield, which = 2, id.n = 0)

```


\newpage

## Figure 5: Log Transformation for *Yield To Maturity*

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(data = bond_data, aes(x = yield_to_maturity)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, color = "black", fill = "white") + 
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of Yield to Maturity",
    x = "Yield to Maturity (in %)",
    y = "Frequency"
    )

p2 <- ggplot(data = bond_data, aes(x = log(yield_to_maturity))) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, color = "black", fill = "white") + 
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of log(Yield to Maturity)",
    x = "log(Yield to Maturity)",
    y = "Frequency"
    )

p1 + p2
```


\newpage

## Figure 9: Model Summary and Diaganostic Plots **With** Log(*Debt/Ebitda Ratio*) 

```{r}
# Compare model performance with vs. without log-transforming Debt/EBITDA
# Figure 9 is with the log transformation, Figure 10 is without the log transformation

lm_yield_2 <- lm(yield_to_maturity ~ log(total_debt_ebitda) + ebitda_margin + 
                   log(market_value) + time_to_maturity, data = bond_data)

summary(lm_yield_2)
plot(lm_yield_2, which = 1, id.n = 0, add.smooth = FALSE)
plot(lm_yield_2, which = 2, id.n = 0)
```

\newpage

## Figure 10: Model Summary and Diaganostic Plots **Without** Log(*Debt/Ebitda Ratio*) 

```{r}
# Compare model performance with vs. without log-transforming Debt/EBITDA
# Figure 9 is with the log transformation, Figure 10 is without the log transformation

lm_yield_3 <- lm(yield_to_maturity ~ total_debt_ebitda + ebitda_margin + 
                   log(market_value) + time_to_maturity, data = bond_data)


summary(lm_yield_3)
plot(lm_yield_3, which = 1, id.n = 0, add.smooth = FALSE)
plot(lm_yield_3, which = 2, id.n = 0)
```

## Figure 11: Scatterplot Matrix After Appropriate Log Transformations

```{r}
plot(~ yield_to_maturity + total_debt_ebitda + ebitda_margin + 
       log(market_value), data = bond_data)
```


\newpage

## Figure 12: Multicollinearity Diagnostics After Appropriate Log Transformations

```{r}
bond_data |> 
  select(yield_to_maturity, total_debt_ebitda, ebitda_margin, market_value) |> 
  mutate(`log(market_value)` = log(market_value)) |> 
  select(-market_value) |> 
  cor()

vif(lm(yield_to_maturity ~ total_debt_ebitda + ebitda_margin + 
         log(market_value), data = bond_data))
```


\newpage

## Figure 13: Model Summary with *Sales* as a Predictor

```{r}
lm_yield_4 <- lm(yield_to_maturity ~ total_debt_ebitda + ebitda_margin + 
                   log(market_value) + time_to_maturity + 
                   sales, data = bond_data)
summary(lm_yield_4)



vif(lm(yield_to_maturity ~ total_debt_ebitda + ebitda_margin + 
         log(market_value) + sales, data = bond_data))

```


\newpage

## Figure 14: Model Summary and Diagnostic Plots with *RBICS Economy* as a Predictor

```{r}
lm_yield_11 <- lm(yield_to_maturity ~ total_debt_ebitda + ebitda_margin + 
                    log(market_value) + time_to_maturity + 
                    rbics_economy, data = bond_data)


summary(lm_yield_11)

plot(lm_yield_11, which = 1, id.n = 0, add.smooth = FALSE)
plot(lm_yield_11, which = 2, id.n = 0)

```



\newpage

## Figure 15: Nested F-Test for *RBICS Economy*

```{r}
#lm_yield_3 is the model without rbics

# Nested F-test to formally evaluate if adding RBICS sector improves model fit
lm_yield_11 <- lm(yield_to_maturity ~ total_debt_ebitda + 
                    time_to_maturity + ebitda_margin + log(market_value) + 
                    rbics_economy, data = bond_data)


anova(lm_yield_3, lm_yield_11, test = "F")
```
\newpage

## Figure 16: Mallow's Cp for *RBICS Economy*
```{r}



bond_data2 <- bond_data |> 
  mutate(issue_date = mdy(issue_date)) 
lm_full <- lm(yield_to_maturity ~ amount_out + issue_date + years_to_maturity + 
                year_matured + rbics_economy + sales + log(market_value) + 
                total_debt_ebitda * time_to_maturity + ebitda_margin, data = bond_data2)
#summary(lm_full)

```

```{r}
#lm_yield_3 is the model without rbics

ols_mallows_cp(lm_yield_11, lm_full)
ols_mallows_cp(lm_yield_3, lm_full)
```



\newpage

## Figure 17: Interaction Between *Debt/EBITDA Ratio* and *Time to Maturity*

```{r}
ggplot(data = bond_data,
  aes(x = total_debt_ebitda, y = yield_to_maturity, 
      color = time_to_maturity, shape = time_to_maturity)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Scatterplot of Yield to Maturity vs Debt/EBITDA by Time to Maturity",
       subtitle = "Data is from 1081 bonds issued in the past year",
       x = "Debt/EBITDA Ratio",
       y = "Yield to Maturity (in %)")
```
\newpage

## Figure 18: Model Summary and Diagnostic Plots for the *Debt/EBITDA* and *Time to Maturity* Interaction

```{r}
# Fit final model incorporating the interaction between Debt/EBITDA and Time to Maturity
lm_yield_final <- lm(yield_to_maturity ~ total_debt_ebitda * time_to_maturity + 
                       ebitda_margin + log(market_value) + rbics_economy, 
                     data = bond_data)


summary(lm_yield_final)
plot(lm_yield_final, which = 1, id.n = 0, add.smooth = FALSE)
plot(lm_yield_final, which = 2, id.n = 0)

```



\newpage


## Figure 19: Nested F-test for the *Debt/EBITDA* and *Time to Maturity* Interaction

```{r}

#lm_yield_11 is the model with no interaction

# # Nested F-test to formally evaluate if adding the interaction improves model fit

anova(lm_yield_11, lm_yield_final, test = "F")
```

\newpage


## Figure 20: Mallow's Cp for the *Debt/EBITDA* and *Time to Maturity* Interaction

```{r}
#lm_yield_11 is the model with no interaction

ols_mallows_cp(lm_yield_11, lm_full)
ols_mallows_cp(lm_yield_final, lm_full)

```

\newpage

## Figure 21: Residual vs Fitted Values by *RBICS Economy*

```{r}

bond_data |>
  add_predictions(lm_yield_final) |> 
  add_residuals(lm_yield_final) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = pred, y = resid)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma")+
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, mapping = aes(color = rbics_economy)) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = F) +
  labs(
    title = "Residual vs Fitted Value Plot by RBICS Sector",
    subtitle = "(for the final model)",
    x = "Fitted Value",
    y = "Residuals"
  )


```


\newpage

## Figure 22: Residual vs Fitted Values by *Time to Maturity*

```{r}

bond_data |>
  add_predictions(lm_yield_final) |> 
  add_residuals(lm_yield_final) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = pred, y = resid)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma")+
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, mapping = aes(color = time_to_maturity)) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = F) +
    labs(
    title = "Residual vs Fitted Value Plot by Time to Maturity",
    subtitle = "(for the final model)",
    x = "Fitted Value",
    y = "Residuals"
  )


```
